September 1, 2023
The General Manager,
Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited,
Stock Exchange Building,
StockExchangeRoad,Karachi.
Dear Sir,
SUBJECT:DISCLOSUREOFMATERIALINFORMATION
In accordance with Section 96 of theSecurities Act 2015,and Clause 5.6.1(a) of the Rule Book of the
Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited, we are pleased to convey the following material information.
This is to inform you that Mr.NavedAbid Khanhas resigned from the Board of Directors of AGP Limited
(the Company),and in his place Mr.Shauzab Ali has been appointed as a Director on the Board of the
Company fortheremainder of the termwith effect fromSeptember 1,2023.
You may please inform TRE Certificate Holders of the Exchange accordingly.
Yours truly
ForandonbehalfofAGPLimited
Umair Mukhtar
Company Secretary
